title: Date Night LED Glow Clear Kayak or Paddleboard & Champagne
includes: Clear Kayak or Paddleboard and all safety equipment
Dry Bag for phone and keys
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This experience combines soft LED under-glow lighting, calm waters, and skyline views for one of the most unique date nights in Orlando. Located on Lake Ivanhoe just north of downtown, you’ll enjoy peaceful paddling with unobstructed views of the city lights reflecting across the water.

The clear kayaks and paddleboards create a glowing ambiance beneath you, while complimentary sparkling wine adds an effortless celebratory touch. With no current, no boat traffic, and no alligators in this lake, guests can fully relax and focus on the moment.

Unlike crowded dinner venues or loud nightlife spots, this guided glow tour offers a quiet, intimate atmosphere where you can sip, paddle, play music, and enjoy the evening at an easy pace.
